claims.text: The data augmentation strategy is called Antecedent-free augmentation (afa), which modifies the gender of pronouns in training data to improve coreference resolution.
Candidates for augmentation are sentences where a coreferential 'it' refers to an antecedent not present in the current or previous sentence, leading to the creation of new training examples.
